findings.message: Every order total now gets a hard-coded 499 cents added on top of the cart subtotal. Nothing in the coupon spec asks for this, so customers would silently be overcharged on every order.
findings.suggestion: return { id, userId: cart.userId, totalCents: subtotalCents(cart) };

criteria.note: `Math.max(0, subtotal - couponCents)` meets the criterion, but no test covers it, including the case where the coupon exceeds the subtotal.

scope_creep.message: Adds an unexplained 499-cent charge to every order total; no listed requirement asks for a fee.
